headline: ECB President Christine Lagarde to Step Down Early in February 2027
summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will resign on February 7, 2027, stepping down nine months before her term official end. The decision comes as the eurozone faces slow economic growth and ongoing inflation concerns.
why: The European Central Bank sets interest rates and monetary policy for the 20 nations sharing the euro currency.
why_moved: Unplanned leadership changes at major central banks generate market uncertainty over future policy direction.
